name: Espressif ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1
description: Breadboard dev board for the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1/1U/2 module with two USB ports (USB-UART and native USB) and 2×22 headers.

specs.label: SoC
specs.value: ESP32-S3, dual-core Xtensa LX7 up to 240 MHz, 512 kB SRAM

specs.label: Module / memory
specs.value: N8R8: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8R8, 8 MB flash + 8 MB PSRAM

specs.label: USB
specs.value: 2× USB: USB-to-UART bridge port and ESP32-S3 native USB OTG port

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 5 V via either USB port or 5V pin; 3.3 V I/O

envelope.axes: x = width, y = length from USB edge (y=0) to antenna end of the PCB; PCB outline only. Module antenna overhang and USB overhang see features. Height not published.

features.label: Header pins
features.value: Two rows of 22 pins, 2.54 mm pitch, centres at x = 1.27 and x = 24.13 mm (row spacing 22.86 mm). Pin centres run from y = 7.96 mm (USB end) to y = 61.30 mm. Drawing labels '1.27 mm' edge inset and '8.00 mm' to the USB edge.

features.label: Module antenna overhang
features.value: WROOM-1 module (18.0 mm wide, x 3.75-21.75) extends past the PCB end: its outline reaches y = 69.15 mm, about 6.4 mm beyond the 62.74 mm edge (from DXF geometry, not a labelled dimension).

features.label: USB connectors
features.value: Two USB receptacles, J2 (UART bridge) and J4 (native USB), on the y=0 edge; connector type is not stated on the drawing. Their outline extends about 0.87 mm past the PCB edge (from DXF geometry, not a labelled dimension).

notes: The connector rows above were read from the official DXF; the USB-receptacle and antenna overhangs are geometry measurements from the same DXF, not labelled dimensions - verify against the board. Espressif's v1.1 board uses the WROOM-1 (PCB antenna); the 1U variant has a U.FL connector and no overhanging antenna. Amazon listing is on the Espressif brand store.
